notes.title: Launch Update 1.0
notes.notes:
After over 6 months of early access we're launching into 1.0! The feedback has been great and we've made some pretty big changes to the game in that time. Thanks to all who participated in the early access release.

Look out for more ghosts, more items, and some other little surprises in the 1.0 version of the game. We're excited to see everyone get a chance to play it!

notes.title: The False King - Update 0.5.2
notes.notes:
All bow to the mighty (and jiggly) False King! A new big boss is in town and he doesn't want to give up the Mask of Okeem so easily. Good luck!

Changes:

 The False King must be defeated to acquire the Mask of Okeem
 Fixed a bug with the UI displaying incorrectly in the chambers


** You can always access the previous build using the Betas tab in preferences

notes.title: Winter Wonderland - Update 0.1.70
notes.notes:
'Twas the night before Christmas when all through the tower
Countless ghosts were stirring, charging up their spooky power...

A little holiday cheer is coming to Weirdwood!

Changes:

 Festive decorations put up
 Special holiday gift with new AoE mechanic
 Ghost attack tweaked on laser eyes
 New Christmas challenge added
 Procedural generation tweaked to prevent wall objects getting hidden
 Bug fix: relic challenge audio fixed


** You can always access the previous build using the Betas tab in preferences

notes.title: Relic Challenges - Update 0.1.50
notes.notes:
Mysterious statues are appearing in the haunted tower.
These relics of Weirdwood seem to contain a spectral energy.
But how curious that they seem to present a challenge?
What rewards or dangers might they bring?

Changes:

 Relics are appearing around the tower
 Totems no longer require challenges
 SteamVR Oculus Touch bindings added (native Oculus support still the default for Rift)
 the Halloween festivities seem to have moved on
 New collectable green fragments (what could these be for?)


** You can always access the previous build using the Betas tab in preferences
